extensionDescription.message: Finds Open Badges baked into images on a page and shows whether they are valid.

actionTitle.message: Scan this page for Open Badges

notBakedExplanation.message: Not an Open Badge: this image contains no Open Badges data. (Badges re-uploaded or resized by some sites lose this data.)

unreadableFetchFailed.message: The image couldn't be downloaded again for inspection.

unreadableNeedsPermission.message: OpenBadge Inspector needs permission to read images from $ORIGIN$. Right-click the image and choose “Inspect Open Badge” to allow it.

unreadableImageCorrupt.message: The image file is damaged, so its metadata can't be read.

unreadableImageTooLarge.message: The image is larger than 10 MB, so it wasn't inspected.

unreadablePayloadTooLarge.message: The badge data in this image is larger than 1 MB, so it wasn't inspected.

unreadableUnsupportedSource.message: This kind of image can't be inspected.

badgeDetailsHosted.message: The badge details are hosted by the issuer. Verify online to load them.

reasonNonStandardBaking.message: Stored in a non-standard place, so other tools may not find this badge.

reasonSchemaValid.message: Matches the Open Badges data model.

reasonSchemaInvalid.message: Doesn't match the Open Badges data model.

reasonSignatureInvalid.message: The signature doesn't match: the badge was changed or not signed by this issuer.

reasonHostedMatch.message: Matches the copy hosted by the issuer.

reasonHostedMismatch.message: Differs from the copy hosted by the issuer.

reasonHostedUnreachable.message: The issuer's copy couldn't be loaded.

reasonNeedsOnline.message: Needs an online check with the issuer.

reasonKeyUnresolved.message: The issuer's public key couldn't be found.

reasonUnsupportedAlgorithm.message: Uses a method this extension doesn't support yet.

reasonUnknownContext.message: Uses a vocabulary this extension can't load offline.

reasonCanonicalisationLimit.message: The credential is too complex to check here.

reasonStatusUnreachable.message: The issuer's revocation status couldn't be loaded.

reasonIssuedInFuture.message: Claims to be issued in the future ($DATE$).

onlineChecked.message: Checked with the issuer just now.

multiplePayloads.message: This image contains $COUNT$ badges. Showing the first one.

scanSummaryNone.message: No Open Badges found ($COUNT$ images checked).

optionAutoScanHelp.message: Marks badges as soon as a page loads. Needs access to all websites. When this is off, scan a page with the toolbar button or right-click an image.

optionNotBakedIconsHelp.message: Shows a grey marker on every scanned image without badge data.

optionPermissionDenied.message: Firefox didn't grant access to websites, so this setting stays off.

optionsPrivacy.message: OpenBadge Inspector reads image metadata on your device. It collects no data and sends nothing anywhere unless you click “Verify online”.

onlineBlocked.message: $HOSTS$ doesn't let browser extensions read its badge data. Allow online checks to reach every issuer in the settings, then verify again.

optionReachAllIssuers.message: Let online checks reach every issuer

optionReachAllIssuersHelp.message: “Verify online” works without this for most issuers. Some issuers block browser extensions from reading badge data; turning this on gives the extension access to all websites so those can be checked too. Issuers are still contacted only when you click “Verify online”, and they can see that you checked the badge.
